references.text: The question of whether the Lord's hand is too short to save or deliver shows that God's power has no limits.
The Lord's hand is not too short to save - the same expression is used to emphasize God's unlimited power.
The question of whether anything is too difficult for the Lord shows that nothing is impossible for God.
Confirms that nothing is too difficult for the Lord, emphasizing God's omnipotence.
God asks if anything is too difficult for him, showing his unlimited power.
The fulfillment of the Lord's word when he sent quail in abundance, as proof that his hand was not too short.
Moses urges the people to see the Lord's salvation, using similar expressions like 'now you will see'.
The angel confirms that nothing is impossible for God, reflecting the Lord's unlimited power.
The Lord's word should not be delayed but fulfilled - confirming that God's word always comes true.
